annotations.title: Rent a Keep a Number line

description: Rent a Keep a Number line: a US real mobile number for one app (or "allservices" = any sender) for 30 or 90 days. This SPENDS the wallet balance. Use search_keep_numbers first for the service id and live price. The result gives a receiptId that works with get_sms_rental_messages, extend_sms_rental (wallet only) and cancel_sms_rental. Some numbers can be cancelled for a full refund for a short time after purchase if no message arrived; otherwise NON-REFUNDABLE once bought, so confirm with the user before buying. Not for financial, gambling, or government verification. Requires a connected agent wallet.

requestId.description: Idempotency key: generate a fresh UUID for each NEW number, and reuse the SAME value when retrying after a timeout or transport error — an identical retry returns the original number instead of charging again.

name: rent_keep_number
